pattern: Overfill is the main giveaway. Generated cards tend to blow the hero up until it presses on the edges, and subject area, box width or box height often run past the real range, with margins of about 0.02 or less. The whole object is forced inside the frame, so secondary parts such as tassels, fire rings and stakes grow large enough to compete with the main form. Real cards leave even air around a clearly ranked hero, or crop it deliberately, as the real lighthouse base is cut by the bottom edge. Smaller generated variants still give themselves away by fitting the complete object plus extra props, instead of committing to a tight crop.
